en.title: Avengers: Doomsday's Biggest Mysteries: Where's Deadpool, Will Monica Return?
en.summary: The MCU's cosmic finale is on the horizon, but gaping plot holes remain. We're diving deep into the burning questions fans desperately need answered before Earth's Mightiest Heroes face their ultimate challenge.
en.body:
The road to **Avengers: Doomsday** has been a winding one, packed with universe-shattering events and the introduction of countless new heroes and villains. With the two-part finale to Marvel's post-Endgame multiverse saga drawing closer, a host of burning questions continue to plague dedicated fans. These aren't just minor quibbles; they represent crucial plot points that could define the very outcome of the conflict against **Doctor Doom** and the threats lurking within the multiverse.

## Unanswered Questions Plague the Multiverse Saga

Chief among these mysteries is the whereabouts of **Deadpool**. While Ryan Reynolds made a surprise appearance at San Diego Comic-Con in 2026, hinting at his involvement and even asking about "last-minute additions," his exact role remains unclear. Will he be a chaotic force for good, a wildcard for Doom, or something else entirely? Adding to the intrigue, footage revealed **Doctor Doom** commanding an army of Sentinels, a chilling callback to mutant lore that suggests **Deadpool**'s presence could be more than just a cameo. Furthermore, the fate of **Monica Rambeau**, last seen adrift in an alternate dimension, is a significant concern. Will she find a way back home, or is her journey in the multiverse more permanent than we anticipate? Details on her return have not yet been announced.

## Fan Theories and Lingering Doubts

The community is abuzz with speculation, particularly concerning the implications of **Doctor Doom**'s grand plan. While his motivations are often tied to control and power, the specifics of his strategy in *Doomsday* remain shrouded in secrecy. Will it involve the vast armies seen in promotional glimpses, or are there deeper, more personal stakes at play? The potential crossover of characters from various corners of the MCU, including the possibility of heroes from the Marvel Television era appearing in *Secret Wars*, fuels further discussion. Fans are also dissecting the interactions between characters; for instance, the dynamic between **Gambit** and **Yelena Belova** is expected to be filled with sharp wit rather than romance, a detail that adds flavor to the ensemble. Meanwhile, the enigmatic **Doctor Strange**'s entanglement with **Victor** via **Clea** is a narrative thread that fans are eager to see explored, with hints suggesting his journey will be a significant part of *Secret Wars*.

## What Lies Ahead

With **Avengers: Doomsday** slated for release in October 2026, anticipation is at an all-time high. The coming months will undoubtedly bring further reveals and trailers, hopefully shedding light on these pressing questions. Until then, fans will continue to dissect every rumor and piece of information, piecing together the puzzle of Marvel's most ambitious cinematic event yet.

content_raw: Where is Deadpool? Why is Steve Rogers back? These and more things we still need to know before 'Doomsday'. Avengers: Doomsday (along with 2027's Avengers: Secret Wars) is the two-part finale to Marvel's post-Endgame multiverse saga. Over the past six years, the MCU has introduced new heroes, villains, and details to its ever-expanding universe.
